review: candidate — promote to its strongest durable form: script fix > lint rule > guide prose. Bar: seen in ≥2 independent runs, verified against ground truth, or reviewer judgment. Contradicted → mark deprecated here (with evidence), don't delete.

learnings.statement: Under host setUnstyledMode(true,{keepFunctionalStyles:true}), Velt component internals (composer input/avatar/send) are reachable by class CSS with shadowDom={false} — so a strictly-primitives build can theme them to a design pill without wireframes
A rotate() transform inflates getBoundingClientRect vs Figma's un-rotated node box and false-FAILs delta box checks; render icon shapes axis-aligned to match the extracted box
learnings.evidence: empty-state doc glyph 41x41 measured 46x46 with rotate(8deg); removing rotation -> 0 diffs

learnings.statement: User/data-dependent elements (composer avatar) render after auth data loads; add a waitFor on the element in drive.steps or the capture races it and delta reports it MISSING
learnings.evidence: avatar MISSING until a waitFor .velt-user-avatar--initial-container was added

learnings.statement: Figma design frames sometimes include non-DOM artifacts as element nodes — a drawn text caret (caret/color-layer) and an empty avatar initial; no implementation (wireframe OR primitive) can match these as DOM boxes, so the planner should omit cursor/empty-content artifacts from the delta spec
learnings.evidence: composer active/typing frames contain caret 4x20 + color-layer 8x20 = the blinking cursor

learnings.statement: measure-block default mode takes <phaseDir> <blockId> with NO 'measure' subcommand; only 'smoke' is a subcommand

VeltCommentComposer opens/expands on focus (velt-composer-open one-way state) and renders no Cancel affordance — a design 'focused-collapsed' or 'typing-with-Cancel' composer state is mode_blocked in strictly primitives; needs VeltCommentComposerWireframe
learnings.evidence: focus expanded the pill 40->53px, shifted send +21px

learnings.statement: VeltCommentDialog (fullExpanded) renders status dropdown + copy-link + options + persistent composer; a minimal restructured thread card (Reply-link default, hover-gated resolve, connector line, 'Show N replies') is mode_blocked in strictly primitives (decision-tree Q2 -> VeltCommentDialogWireframe ThreadCard slots)
learnings.evidence: seeded card DOM: status-dropdown 85x24, options kebab, copy-link, resolve, reply composer — none in the design
